fullText.simplified:
第二章、跳进瀑布

    猴子们在清凉的河水里玩，突然想到一个问题，水是从哪里来的？
    老猴子想了想，说：“我们跟着水向上走，应该就能知道水是从哪儿来的。”
    “走！走！”猴子们马上兴奋了起来，跟着河水往山上跑。
    大家穿过高高的树林，爬过大块的石头。接着，他们听到了流水的声音，那声音越来越大。
    跑在前面的猴子大叫了一声：“天啊！快看上面！”
    大家抬头看，发现了一个从天而下的大瀑布。水从高高的山上流下来，好像一个白色的大帘子，在阳光下发光。
    猴子们从来没看过大瀑布，又兴奋又害怕。大家你一言我一语，说了起来。
    “你们猜这大帘子后面是什么？”
    “能进去吗？谁敢进去看看？”
    “你的意思是跳进这大瀑布里？我害怕，我不敢！”
    这时候，老猴子说话了。他举起手里的树枝，问道：“谁敢跳进瀑布看看后面有什么？如果谁敢跳，还能活着回来，我们就选谁做大王！”
    谁去呢？大家你看看我，我看看你，谁也不敢动。
    “我去！”石猴一下子跳了出来，大声说道。
    “你会死的，这太危险了。”一只小黑猴拉住了他的尾巴，担心地说道。
    石猴笑了笑，他好像一点儿也不害怕。他说：“如果我没死，我请你们吃甜果子！”
    “一、二、三！”石猴深深吸了一口气，然后向前一跳，进了瀑布……
    石猴往里看，他吃惊地发现眼前是一座石桥，桥后面是一个大山洞！洞里有石床、石桌、石碗，石头上还刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”几个大字。
    这是什么意思？花果山是这座山的名字，那水帘洞是哪里？
fullText.traditional:
第二章、跳進瀑布

    猴子們在清涼的河水裡玩，突然想到一個問題，水是從哪裡來的？
    老猴子想了想，說：“我們跟著水向上走，應該就能知道水是從哪兒來的。”
    “走！走！”猴子們馬上興奮了起來，跟著河水往山上跑。
    大家穿過高高的樹林，爬過大塊的石頭。接著，他們聽到了流水的聲音，那聲音越來越大。
    跑在前面的猴子大叫了一聲：“天啊！快看上面！”
    大家抬頭看，發現了一個從天而下的大瀑布。水從高高的山上流下來，好像一個白色的大簾子，在陽光下發光。
    猴子們從來沒看過大瀑布，又興奮又害怕。大家你一言我一語，說了起來。
    “你們猜這大簾子後面是什麼？”
    “能進去嗎？誰敢進去看看？”
    “你的意思是跳進這大瀑布裡？我害怕，我不敢！”
    這時候，老猴子說話了。他舉起手裡的樹枝，問道：“誰敢跳進瀑布看看後面有什麼？如果誰敢跳，還能活著回來，我們就選誰做大王！”
    誰去呢？大家你看看我，我看看你，誰也不敢動。
    “我去！”石猴一下子跳了出來，大聲說道。
    “你會死的，這太危險了。”一隻小黑猴拉住了他的尾巴，擔心地說道。
    石猴笑了笑，他好像一點兒也不害怕。他說：“如果我沒死，我請你們吃甜果子！”
    “一、二、三！”石猴深深吸了一口氣，然後向前一跳，進了瀑布……
    石猴往裡看，他吃驚地發現眼前是一座石橋，橋後面是一個大山洞！洞裡有石床、石桌、石碗，石頭上還刻著“花果山福地，水簾洞洞天”幾個大字。
    這是什麼意思？花果山是這座山的名字，那水簾洞是哪裡？

sentences.english: The monkeys were playing in the cool river water when they suddenly thought of a question: Where did this water come from?

sentences.traditional: 老猴子想了想，說：“我們跟著水向上走，應該就能知道水是從哪兒來的。”

sentences.english: The old monkey thought for a moment and said, “If we follow the water upstream, we should be able to find out where it comes from.”

sentences.traditional: “走！走！”猴子們馬上興奮了起來，跟著河水往山上跑。

sentences.english: “Let’s go! Let’s go!” The monkeys immediately became excited and ran up the mountain, following the river.

sentences.simplified: 大家穿过高高的树林，爬过大块的石头。
sentences.traditional: 大家穿過高高的樹林，爬過大塊的石頭。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā chuān guò gāo gāo de shù lín pá guò dà kuài de shí tou
sentences.english: They all passed through the tall forest and climbed over large rocks.

sentences.simplified: 接着，他们听到了流水的声音，那声音越来越大。
sentences.traditional: 接著，他們聽到了流水的聲音，那聲音越來越大。
sentences.pinyin: jiē zhe tā men tīng dào le liú shuǐ de shēng yīn nà shēng yīn yuè lái yuè dà
sentences.english: Then, they heard the sound of running water, and the sound grew louder and louder.

sentences.simplified: 跑在前面的猴子大叫了一声：“天啊！快看上面！”
sentences.traditional: 跑在前面的猴子大叫了一聲：“天啊！快看上面！”

sentences.english: The monkey running in front shouted, “Oh my! Look above!”

sentences.simplified: 大家抬头看，发现了一个从天而下的大瀑布。
sentences.traditional: 大家抬頭看，發現了一個從天而下的大瀑布。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā tái tóu kàn fā xiàn le yí ge cóng tiān ér xià de dà pù bù
sentences.english: Everyone looked up and discovered a great waterfall cascading down from the sky.

sentences.simplified: 水从高高的山上流下来，好像一个白色的大帘子，在阳光下发光。
sentences.traditional: 水從高高的山上流下來，好像一個白色的大簾子，在陽光下發光。

sentences.english: The water flowed down from the tall mountain, like a great white curtain, shining in the sunlight.

sentences.simplified: 猴子们从来没看过大瀑布，又兴奋又害怕。

sentences.english: The monkeys had never seen a big waterfall before, and they were both excited and afraid.

sentences.simplified: 大家你一言我一语，说了起来。
sentences.traditional: 大家你一言我一語，說了起來。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā nǐ yì yán wǒ yì yǔ shuō le qǐ lái
sentences.english: Everyone began talking at once, each with something to say.

sentences.simplified: “你们猜这大帘子后面是什么？”
sentences.traditional: “你們猜這大簾子後面是什麼？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ men cāi zhè dà lián zi hòu miàn shì shén me
sentences.english: “Can you guess what is behind this big curtain?”

sentences.simplified: “能进去吗？谁敢进去看看？”
sentences.traditional: “能進去嗎？誰敢進去看看？”
sentences.pinyin: néng jìn qù ma shéi gǎn jìn qù kàn kan
sentences.english: “Can we go in? Who dares to go in and take a look?”

sentences.simplified: “你的意思是跳进这大瀑布里？我害怕，我不敢！”
sentences.traditional: “你的意思是跳進這大瀑布裡？我害怕，我不敢！”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de yì si shì tiào jìn zhè dà pù bù lǐ wǒ hài pà wǒ bù gǎn
sentences.english: “You mean to jump into this big waterfall? I’m scared, I don’t dare!”

sentences.simplified: 这时候，老猴子说话了。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，老猴子說話了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou lǎo hóu zi shuō huà le
sentences.english: At this moment, the old monkey spoke.

sentences.traditional: 他舉起手裡的樹枝，問道：“誰敢跳進瀑布看看後面有什麼？
sentences.pinyin: tā jǔ qǐ shǒu lǐ de shù zhī wèn dào shéi gǎn tiào jìn pù bù kàn kan hòu miàn yǒu shén me
sentences.english: He raised the branch in his hand and asked, “Who dares to jump into the waterfall to see what’s behind it?

sentences.simplified: 如果谁敢跳，还能活着回来，我们就选谁做大王！”
sentences.traditional: 如果誰敢跳，還能活著回來，我們就選誰做大王！”

sentences.english: If anyone dares to jump and can come back alive, we will choose that one to be our king.”

sentences.simplified: 谁去呢？大家你看看我，我看看你，谁也不敢动。
sentences.traditional: 誰去呢？大家你看看我，我看看你，誰也不敢動。
sentences.pinyin: shéi qù ne dà jiā nǐ kàn kan wǒ wǒ kàn kan nǐ shéi yě bù gǎn dòng
sentences.english: Who will go? Everyone looked at each other, and no one dared to move.

sentences.traditional: “我去！”石猴一下子跳了出來，大聲說道。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ qù shí hóu yí xià zi tiào le chu lai dà shēng shuō dào
sentences.english: “I’ll go!” The stone monkey suddenly jumped out and said loudly.

sentences.simplified: “你会死的，这太危险了。”一只小黑猴拉住了他的尾巴，担心地说道。
sentences.traditional: “你會死的，這太危險了。”一隻小黑猴拉住了他的尾巴，擔心地說道。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ huì sǐ de zhè tài wēi xiǎn le yì zhī xiǎo hēi hóu lā zhù le tā de wěi ba dān xīn de shuō dào
sentences.english: “You will die. It’s too dangerous.” A little black monkey pulled his tail and said worriedly.

sentences.simplified: 石猴笑了笑，他好像一点儿也不害怕。
sentences.traditional: 石猴笑了笑，他好像一點兒也不害怕。
sentences.pinyin: shí hóu xiào le xiào tā hǎo xiàng yì diǎn'r yě bú hài pà
sentences.english: The stone monkey smiled. He didn’t seem scared at all.

sentences.simplified: 他说：“如果我没死，我请你们吃甜果子！”
sentences.traditional: 他說：“如果我沒死，我請你們吃甜果子！”
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō rú guǒ wǒ méi sǐ wǒ qǐng nǐ men chī tián guǒ zi
sentences.english: He said, “If I don’t die, I’ll treat you all to sweet fruits!”

sentences.traditional: “一、二、三！”石猴深深吸了一口氣，然後向前一跳，進了瀑布……
sentences.pinyin: yī èr sān shí hóu shēn shēn xī le yì kǒu qì rán hòu xiàng qián yí tiào jìn le pù bù
sentences.english: “One, two, three!” The stone monkey took a deep breath, then jumped forward into the waterfall …

sentences.traditional: 石猴往裡看，他吃驚地發現眼前是一座石橋，
sentences.pinyin: shí hóu wǎng lǐ kàn tā chī jīng de fā xiàn yǎn qián shì yí zuò shí qiáo
sentences.english: The stone monkey looked inside, and to his surprise, he discovered a stone bridge in front of him.

sentences.simplified: 桥后面是一个大山洞！
sentences.traditional: 橋後面是一個大山洞！
sentences.pinyin: qiáo hòu miàn shì yí ge dà shān dòng
sentences.english: Behind the stone bridge, there was a large cave!

sentences.simplified: 洞里有石床、石桌、石碗，
sentences.traditional: 洞裡有石床、石桌、石碗，
sentences.pinyin: dòng lǐ yǒu shí chuáng shí zhuō shí wǎn
sentences.english: Inside the cave, there was a stone bed, a stone table, and stone bowls.

sentences.simplified: 石头上还刻着“花果山福地，水帘洞洞天”几个大字。
sentences.traditional: 石頭上還刻著“花果山福地，水簾洞洞天”幾個大字。
sentences.pinyin: shí tou shang hái kè zhe huā guǒ shān fú dì shuǐ lián dòng dòng tiān jǐ ge dà zì
sentences.english: On the rock, several large characters were engraved: “Blessed Land of Mount Huaguo, Water Curtain Cave”.

sentences.traditional: 這是什麼意思？花果山是這座山的名字，那水簾洞是哪裡？

sentences.english: What did this mean? Mount Huaguo was the name of this mountain, so where was the Water Curtain Cave?

sentence_translations: Chapter 2: Jumping Into the Waterfall
The monkeys were playing in the cool river water when they suddenly thought of a question: Where did this water come from?
The old monkey thought for a moment and said, “If we follow the water upstream, we should be able to find out where it comes from.”
“Let’s go! Let’s go!” The monkeys immediately became excited and ran up the mountain, following the river.
They all passed through the tall forest and climbed over large rocks.
Then, they heard the sound of running water, and the sound grew louder and louder.
The monkey running in front shouted, “Oh my! Look above!”
Everyone looked up and discovered a great waterfall cascading down from the sky.
The water flowed down from the tall mountain, like a great white curtain, shining in the sunlight.
The monkeys had never seen a big waterfall before, and they were both excited and afraid.
Everyone began talking at once, each with something to say.
“Can you guess what is behind this big curtain?”
“Can we go in? Who dares to go in and take a look?”
“You mean to jump into this big waterfall? I’m scared, I don’t dare!”
At this moment, the old monkey spoke.
He raised the branch in his hand and asked, “Who dares to jump into the waterfall to see what’s behind it?
If anyone dares to jump and can come back alive, we will choose that one to be our king.”
Who will go? Everyone looked at each other, and no one dared to move.
“I’ll go!” The stone monkey suddenly jumped out and said loudly.
“You will die. It’s too dangerous.” A little black monkey pulled his tail and said worriedly.
The stone monkey smiled. He didn’t seem scared at all.
He said, “If I don’t die, I’ll treat you all to sweet fruits!”
“One, two, three!” The stone monkey took a deep breath, then jumped forward into the waterfall …
The stone monkey looked inside, and to his surprise, he discovered a stone bridge in front of him.
Behind the stone bridge, there was a large cave!
Inside the cave, there was a stone bed, a stone table, and stone bowls.
On the rock, several large characters were engraved: “Blessed Land of Mount Huaguo, Water Curtain Cave”.
What did this mean? Mount Huaguo was the name of this mountain, so where was the Water Curtain Cave?
